deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications run October 1, 2026 to January 19, 2027.
deadline.quote: PhD Thesis in Computing Science - Accepting applications for Fall 2027: October 1 - January 19, 2027

gre_general.quote: Are GRE scores required? | No, they are not.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You can apply without a confirmed supervisor, but admission needs a faculty member available to supervise you, so contacting faculty first can help.
supervisor.quote: You do not need a confirmed supervisor to submit an application, but in order to receive admission a faculty member must be available to act as your supervisor. You do not have to contact faculty to get a commitment but it can be advantageous to communicate with faculty prior to applying to our thesis-based programs.

funding.value: Every PhD student is guaranteed at least CAD 30,000 a year for four years.
funding.quote: Every PhD student is guaranteed a minimum funding of $30,000 per year for four years.

entry_route.value: A standard track for master's holders and a direct-entry track from a bachelor's (CGPA 3.5/4.33 or 3.67 on the last 60 units, with extra courses).
entry_route.quote: Standard Track: a master's degree in Computing Science or related field | Direct-entry Track: a bachelor's (but not master's) degree in Computing Science or related field

notes: A Spring (January) intake also exists. SFU-ZJU dual-degree PhD available.
